scope.description: One complete frozen response, all token positions, fixed reference-A outcome direction; FP32 eager SUM(weight * residual * logp) gradients. No new probe/JVP, optimizer step, full-batch/Adam update or accuracy claim.

exact_jvp.definition: sum_t FP32_weight_t * saved_exact_JVP_score_t; linear identity up to oracle/FP32 backward rounding

master_precision_provenance.sample_method: uniform stride across concatenated model parameter elements
master_precision_provenance.interpretation: BF16 Base weights promoted to FP32 may be on-grid; trained FP32 masters may be off-grid

limitations: One full response and one fixed reference-A direction; not the previous N32 selected-token case
Every recipe is FP32 eager target backward; only frozen weights differ
SUM reduction; no full-batch aggregation, Adam/momentum, PPO ratio, clipping or optimizer step
Oracle fixed-probe projection is a local surrogate alignment, not an accuracy change
Exact-JVP sigmoid weights are a comparison reference, not a globally optimal weighting rule
